identity.name: RISEx Direxion South Korea Bull 3X ETF Perp

about.description: ETF perpetual on RISEx tracking the Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X ETF, which seeks 300% of the daily performance of the MSCI Korea 25/50 Index, cash-settled and margined in USDC, up to 5x leverage. RISEx is a fully onchain orderbook perp DEX on RISE Chain, where the orderbook shares state with DeFi protocols in the same block. Index price from Stork (median CEX spot); mark price is the median of an index-anchored premium, the raw book signal and a Stork anchor. Trades 24/7 including nights, weekends and holidays when the underlying market is closed, so liquidity thins during off-hours.
